seo.projects.rag.title: Secure RAG Assistant — Full-stack AI project | LEXOFT
seo.projects.rag.description: Enterprise RAG system with role-based access control: Spring Boot, Spring AI, AWS Bedrock (Claude), pgvector, Keycloak and Terraform.
projects.rag.detail.tagline: A production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation system with role-based document access control — built as a proof-of-concept for enterprise internal knowledge management.
projects.rag.detail.overview.title: What it does
projects.rag.detail.overview.body: Users authenticate via SSO (Keycloak / OIDC) and query a document knowledge base through a conversational AI interface. The system enforces data-access policies at the retrieval layer: an employee only ever receives answers grounded in documents their role permits them to see.
projects.rag.detail.highlights.title: Key engineering highlights
projects.rag.detail.h1.title: Role-scoped RAG retrieval
projects.rag.detail.h1.body: JWT roles map to a privilege hierarchy at query time via pgvector metadata filtering — access policy is enforced at the vector-search layer, not just the UI.
projects.rag.detail.h2.title: Multi-layer prompt guard
projects.rag.detail.h2.body: Zero-cost regex / blocklist pre-screening, Amazon Comprehend toxicity detection, and a canary-word advisor that detects system-prompt exfiltration attempts.
projects.rag.detail.h3.title: Two-phase LLM pipeline
projects.rag.detail.h3.body: Tool-first pass (MCP / SSE) with RAG fallback; multi-query expansion (4 variants) improves retrieval recall.
projects.rag.detail.h4.title: Dual ingestion modes
projects.rag.detail.h4.body: REST endpoint for local development; SQS consumer in production (S3 event notifications → async chunk-embed-store pipeline).
projects.rag.detail.h5.title: Multi-module Maven architecture
projects.rag.detail.h5.body: A shared common library (embeddings, role model) consumed by independent Spring Boot services.
projects.rag.detail.architecture.title: Architecture
projects.rag.detail.insight: The key architectural insight is the trust boundary at retrieval: security is enforced inside RoleFilterDocumentRetriever — the LLM never receives documents the user isn't permitted to see, regardless of what they ask.

seo.projects.agent.title: AI Appointment Scheduler — Full-stack AI agent | LEXOFT
seo.projects.agent.description: A conversational AI appointment-booking agent (hair salon): Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, LangChain, Claude and Angular 21.
projects.agent.detail.tagline: A full-stack, AI-powered scheduling system for a hair salon: customers book appointments through a natural-language chat interface instead of a traditional form.
projects.agent.detail.overview.title: What it does
projects.agent.detail.overview.body: Customers describe what they need in plain English (“I'd like highlights next Saturday at 2pm”) and a conversational AI agent handles the entire booking flow — checking availability, confirming details, and optionally collecting payment — all in a single chat thread.
projects.agent.detail.highlights.title: Key engineering highlights
projects.agent.detail.h1.title: LangGraph ReAct agent
projects.agent.detail.h1.body: A tool-calling loop (check availability → book → request payment), compiled once at startup and shared across all concurrent sessions via checkpoint-keyed conversation state.
projects.agent.detail.h2.title: Dual request-path architecture
projects.agent.detail.h2.body: The agent handles customer interactions while admin reads bypass the LLM entirely for direct, low-latency service access.
projects.agent.detail.h3.title: Structured payment trigger
projects.agent.detail.h3.body: The agent emits a structured sentinel via a tool response; the backend extracts it and the frontend renders an inline payment modal — with no client-side prompt parsing.
projects.agent.detail.h4.title: Clean service boundary
projects.agent.detail.h4.body: All persistence logic lives in a single service class, making the storage layer swappable without touching the agent or the API.
projects.agent.detail.h5.title: Natural-language dates
projects.agent.detail.h5.body: With python-dateparser, the agent passes the user’s phrasing verbatim to tools rather than forcing ISO format on the customer.
projects.agent.detail.architecture.title: Architecture
projects.agent.detail.insight: The key architectural insight is the payment trigger: the agent emits a payment_request sentinel via a tool response, extracted on the backend — the frontend renders a payment modal without ever parsing the LLM’s text.
